human_owner.summary: Approved in advance by the owner through auto mode; the Claude reviewer decides.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Glenohumeral flexion at full weight makes the clavicular head of pectoralis major a 0.7 primary mover. In a strict vertical press its role is probably smaller than the deltoids and triceps, so this is somewhat generous. The table assigns this weight to the action, and the frames show a front-of-body, scapular-plane path, so the result is defensible.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_correction: If a future revision wants less pectoral emphasis, consider treating flexion as an assist action or relying more on scapular-plane abduction. This is optional.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Long head and short head of biceps brachii and coracobrachialis appear as 0.3 synergists, from the shoulder flexion table weights. Their real contribution to a seated overhead press is small. This comes from the tracer's table and is not a definition error.

No trunk demands are listed. The bench has back support, so the omission is reasonable, but light trunk and anti-extension work is not captured. The assumption is stated openly and the frames show a supported seat, so this is acceptable.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_correction: Optionally add a light anti_extension_spine demand if reviewers want the trunk bracing represented.

model_reviewer.summary: The definition correctly identifies a seated, bilateral barbell overhead press with a pronated grip, supported by both frames (shoulder-height rack position to overhead lockout on a back-supported bench). Bilateral laterality, open-chain classification, vertical_push family, glenohumeral flexion and abduction, elbow extension and scapular upward rotation all fit the movement. The grip and wrist_stability demands fit a load held in the hands, and the rotator-cuff and scapular demands fit overhead pressing. The tracer pattern is plausible: deltoids, triceps, serratus anterior and upper trapezius are primary, with rotator cuff and forearm muscles as stabilizers. Nothing material is wrong or missing.
